topography.project_purpose: Bridge. Structurally: 83 project-authored contract(s) across 8 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens, 8 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 39 common project-authored base contract(s) (immutablestate, dsmath, dsauth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
